    if type(weights) ~= "table" then
        error("weights must be a table")
    end

    -- Check if weights is nonempty
    if #weights == 0 then

    end

    -- Check if weights contains only nonnegative numbers
    for _, weight in pairs(weights) do
        if weight < 0 then
            error("weights must contain only nonnegative numbers")
        end
    end

    -- Check if weights has a finite total
    local total = 0
    for _, weight in pairs(weights) do
        total = total + weight
        if total == math.huge or math.isinf(total) then
            error("weights must have a finite total")
        end
    end

    -- Check if ticket is finite in the range [0, total)
    if ticket < 0 or ticket >= total then
        error("ticket must be finite in the range [0, total)")
    end

    -- Generate a random number between 0 and total
    local random = math.random(total)

    -- Find the 1-based index of the selected weight
    local index = 1
    local cumulative = 0
    for _, weight in pairs(weights) do
        cumulative = cumulative + weight
        if random <= cumulative then
            return index
        end
        index = index + 1
    end

    -- This should never happen, but just in case
    error("Failed to find index")
end

local function snap(value, minimum, maximum, steps)
    -- Check if all inputs are valid
    if type(value) ~= "number" or type(minimum) ~= "number" or type(maximum) ~= "number" or type(steps) ~= "number" then
        return nil
    end

    if minimum > maximum then
        return nil
    end

    if value < minimum or value > maximum then
        return nil
    end

    if steps < 1 or steps > 1000000 then
        return nil
    end

    -- Calculate the step size
    local stepSize = (maximum - minimum) / steps

    -- Calculate the snapped value and its index
    local snappedValue = math.ceil((value - minimum) / stepSize) * stepSize + minimum
    local stepIndex = math.floor((value - minimum) / stepSize)

    -- Clamp the snapped value to the range
    if snappedValue < minimum then
        snappedValue = minimum
    elseif snappedValue > maximum then
        snappedValue = maximum
    end

    -- Clamp the step index to the range
    if stepIndex < 0 then
        stepIndex = 0
    elseif stepIndex >= steps then
        stepIndex = steps - 1
    end

    return {snappedValue, stepIndex}
end

return snap

    local fresh = {}
    for i = 1, #queue do
        if queue[i] ~= message then break end
    end
    if i > #queue then fresh = queue end
    for i = fresh + 1, #queue do
        fresh[i - 1] = queue[i]
    end
    if #fresh > limit then fresh = fresh - limit + 1 end
    return fresh
end
